lean.statement:
{V : E → ℝ} {α η : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E, α*‖v‖^2 ≤ fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v v) (hη : 0 < η) :
    let ZV := ∫ x, Real.exp (-V x) ∂(volume : Measure E)
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let C := ((Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*η))⁻¹)^Module.finrank ℝ E
    let A := fun y : E => C*∫ x, Real.exp (-V x-‖y-x‖^2/(2*η)) ∂(volume : Measure E)
    0 < ZV ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧
      (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map (fun p => p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2) =
        (volume : Measure E).withDensity
          (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(-Real.log (A y)))/ZV)) ∧
      Integrable A (volume : Measure E) ∧
      (∫ y, A y ∂(volume : Measure E)) = ZV ∧
      (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map (fun p => p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2) =
        (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun y => -(-Real.log (A y))) ∧
      (∀ y, 0 < A y) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y => -Real.log (A y)) ∧
      ∀ y, -Real.log (C*∫ x, Real.exp (-‖y-x‖^2/(2*η)) ∂μ) =
        -Real.log (A y)+Real.log ZV
approved_definition_context: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space equipped with its Borel measurable space, including dimension zero. V:E->R is C2. alpha and eta are strictly positive reals; the displayed lower Hessian inequality holds for every x and v. fderiv R(fderiv R V)x v v is the second Frechet derivative applied twice to v.

volume is canonical Lebesgue measure on E. A real integral is the Bochner integral. volume.tilted(-V) means withDensity(ofReal(exp(-V)/integral exp(-V))). Measure.prod means independent product and Measure.map is measurable pushforward. stdGaussian E is centered identity-covariance Gaussian.

Real.exp/log are real exponential/logarithm, ENNReal.ofReal is the nonnegative density coercion, ContDiff R 2 means globally twice continuously Frechet differentiable. All local let expressions define the actual displayed integrals and functions, including the unnormalized negative-log convolution and normalized negative-log probability density.
